kong35.text:
默认显示位置在屏幕右上角
作为壁纸运行总时长
当壁纸设置为开机自启动 可大致判定你电脑开机多久
The default display location is at the upper right corner of the screen.
It represents the total running time of the wallpaper.
When the wallpaper is set to start up automatically with the computer, it can roughly tell how long your computer has been booted up.

kong37.text:
搭配上面的全局设置进行合理调节
Make reasonable adjustments in conjunction with the above - mentioned global settings.

kong47.text:
【调节大小】针对自定义背景
适合在不同尺寸显示器中进行放大缩�?br>调节合理 可适配多种横屏显示器尺�?br>包括�?6:9 16:10 21:9 32:9

[Size Adjustment] for Custom Background
It is suitable for zooming in and out on different - sized monitors.
With reasonable adjustment, it can adapt to various landscape - mode monitor sizes,
including 16:9, 16:10, 21:9, and 32:9.

kong56.text:
额外的启动按钮 默认位于屏幕右下角
The additional start button is by default located in the lower right corner of the screen.

It is recommended to turn it on after the settings are completed to prevent the automatic hiding during the setting process from affecting the operation.

📍进度条相关 Progress Bar Relate

正版播放器多数不支持 反倒是一些开源的第三方播放器支持💀

Regarding the progress bar function: Not all media players support this feature.
According to the test results report in 2025: Most legitimate players do not support it, while some open - source third - party players do.💀
